feats.title: Agile Command
feats.description: Any ally who starts his or her turn adjacent to you gains a +2 feat bonus to AC and Reflex against opportunity attacks until the end of his or her turn.

feats.title: Bravura Shroud
feats.description: Whenever an ally chooses to benefit from your Bravura Presence class feature, that ally gains concealment until the end of its next turn.

feats.title: Combat Commander
feats.description: The bonus to initiative granted by your Combat Leader class feature is now equal to your Charisma or your Intelligence, whichever is higher.

feats.title: Defense of the Inspired
feats.description: Whenever an ally with line of sight to you takes the total defense action, the bonus to his or her defenses equals your Charisma.

feats.title: Defensive Surge
feats.description: When you use your second wind, you can grant the +2 bonus to all defenses to an adjacent ally, in addition to gaining the bonus yourself.

feats.title: Fight On
feats.description: You can use your inspiring word one additional time per encounter.

feats.title: Impetuous Charger
feats.description: When you charge an enemy, your allies gain combat advantage against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Improved Battlefront Shift
feats.description: Your battlefront shift power targets one additional character.

feats.title: Insightful Preparation
feats.description: Any ally within 5 squares of you gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls against enemies that have not yet acted during the encounter.

feats.title: Phalanx Warrior
feats.requirements: 11th level, Proficiency with light or heavy shields
feats.description: When you are using a shield, adjacent allies gain a +1 shield bonus to AC.

feats.title: Reliable Resources
feats.description: When an ally who can see you spends an action point to take an extra action and doesn't use that action to make an attack, the ally gains temporary hit points equal to your Charisma.

feats.title: Tactician's Word
feats.description: When you use inspiring word, the target gains a bonus equal to one-half your Intelligence to its next attack roll made before the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Versatile Word
feats.description: When you use inspiring word, in addition to the benefit of the power, the target can either shift a number of squares equal to one-half your Charisma as a free action or gain a bonus to AC equal to one-half your Intelligence until the start of its next turn.

feats.title: Vital Inspiration
feats.description: Any ally who can see and hear you adds your Charisma to the hit points regained by using second wind.

feats.title: Warlord's Formation
feats.description: When you use the aid another, aid attack, or aid defense action, you can target up to two allies with that action.
